reports.rendered_content: Panoptic Rendered Object Finder (PanoRef) algorithm implementation assessed: correctness 7.5/10, production readiness 4/10. Core strengths include deterministic area-proportional sampling, actual segment occlusion evaluation, and a genuinely non-greedy joint-pair search mode. Two critical blockers remain: (1) imported sets incorrectly use whole-object AABBs for candidate clearance, causing valid interior origins to be rejected; (2) the geometry representation lacks scalability for heavy imports.
